# Gala checklist

For every home gala, the [Lead Organiser](gala_roles.qmd) needs to ensure the 
following tasks are completed.
The person in the named role is responsible for ensuring the tasks assigned to 
that roll are completed.

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(gt)

data <- read.csv("gala-checklist.csv", check.names = FALSE) |>
    mutate(Timing = factor(Timing, levels=c("Before","During","After "))) |>
    arrange(Timing) |>
    gt() |>
    fmt_markdown(columns = `Responsible Person`) |>
    data_color(columns = Timing,
    target_columns = everything(),
    method = "factor",
    palette = c("#ABDEE6","#F3B0C3","#CCE2CB"),
    alpha = 0.3) 
data 
```

Responsibilities
Lead organiser: coordinate the completion of the gala checklist, ensuring all
other contributors fulfill their roles on time.

wine and chocolates for officials
entry bands
payment card machine
float for entries and raffle
